errors.evidence: The line connecting the data points is white, not silvery as stated in the description.

errors.text_span: Линията започва от 47,3 през 2009 година и следва посоката надолу с малки промени до 33,3 през 2020 година.
errors.evidence: This statement inaccurately simplifies the trend. While the overall trend is downward, the line first increases from 47.3 in 2009 to a peak of 52.3 in 2012 before beginning its descent. The description omits this initial upward movement.
The description fails to mention that the line connecting the data points is a dashed line, which is a noticeable stylistic feature of the chart.
